description: Fully static phone consent page: static/tv/index.html + consent.js (vanilla, zero deps) + static/tv/sample-config.json. Page reads user_hash/customer_id/config_url from querystring (URLSearchParams), validates 64-hex user_hash, fetches config_url, renders {gtm_key:bool} category toggles (always_on disabled+checked), on Save calls POST /_test/sign then POST /universal_consent with platform:'ctv_qr' and HMAC headers. NO completion call. Comment clearly that _test/sign is the local stand-in for first-party server signing.

SSE push endpoint GET /universal_consent/events?customer_id=&user_hash= -> text/event-stream. Register asyncio.Queue in module-level _subscribers dict keyed by (customer_id, user_hash). Keepalive comment every ~15s. Hook existing save_consent: after STORE.put + webhook fan-out, push 'event: updated\ndata: <get_response>' to subscribers for (customer_id, user_hash), behind an 'if subscribers' check. Cleanup queue in finally / on request.is_disconnected(). SDK v1 does NOT consume this.
verification: Open curl -N 'http://localhost:8080/universal_consent/events?customer_id=cust-1&user_hash='$UH in one shell; in another POST a consent write for that user_hash via _test/sign; assert an 'event: updated' line arrives on the stream within 2s.

description: QR pairing layer (no session API). Network/PairingService.swift (no platform guard, pure Foundation): qrURL(publicBaseUrl,customerId,userHash,configUrl)->URL (pure string assembly), fetchConsent(...) GETs /universal_consent?customer_id=&user_hash= with X-DG-Api-Key + Cache-Control:no-cache, returns enum PairingRead {notFound; found(ConsentPreferences)}. QRCodeGenerator.swift (#if canImport(CoreImage)) wrapping CIFilter.qrCodeGenerator() -> UIImage. PairingCoordinator.swift (#if os(tvOS)) owns 2s poll loop + client-side 10-min timeout + fallback to D-pad banner; PairingTransport/PollingTransport seam for future SSE (do NOT build SSE in SDK). ConsentManager.adoptRemotePreferences(_:) (stores + fires onConsentChanged, no re-POST). DataGrailConsent.showBannerWithQRPairing(from:publicBaseUrl:configUrl:userIdentifier:completion:) (tvOS-only). Add optional apiKey init param for reads.
verification: HOST E2E: tvOS sim shows banner+QR -> scan with phone on LAN -> static page loads -> toggle marketing off + Save -> within ~2s sim banner auto-dismisses and isCategoryEnabled('dg-category-marketing')==false; local webhook receiver shows consent.preferences.updated.
